trace.label: chair-before-paper
trace.speech: A tall-backed chair with dark green paint worn down to the wood. It belongs to no set: older than the suite and half a head higher, and somebody put it here facing the same way as the armchair, as though the two of them were waiting together.

trace.label: first-paper
trace.speech: Six years he had on me. He would have heard this room before he was in it.

trace.label: host-revisited
trace.speech: The console on the inventory. The lip of the swollen drawer is bright where somebody worked at it. The return date was left blank.

trace.label: chair-after-paper
trace.speech: The green chair on the inventory. The paint is nearly gone. It is still facing the same way as the armchair, as though the two of them were waiting together.

fixture.meaning: Isolated fixture removes only this note receipt and the three furniture inspection receipts. One nearby placement per existing object, ordinary short step/E/ESC thereafter. No geometry or paper bake changed.

method: Actual existing drawer/page/chair interactions; author-run diagnostic placements and short ordinary steps. Source/side-effect tests separately establish silent reopening. No participant discovery or natural approach claim.
